open.format.full.text: The Speaking test has three parts and lasts between eleven and fourteen minutes. In Part 1, I will ask you some questions about yourself and about familiar topics. In Part 2, I will give you a topic. You will have one minute to prepare, and then you will speak about it for one to two minutes. In Part 3, we will discuss some more general questions connected to that topic. Please answer each question as fully as you can.

open.format.part1.text: Today you will practice Part 1 of the Speaking test. This part lasts four to five minutes. I will ask you some questions about yourself and about familiar, everyday topics. Please answer naturally and give some detail.

open.format.part2.text: Today you will practice Part 2 of the Speaking test. This part lasts three to four minutes. I will give you a topic. You will have one minute to prepare, and you may make notes. Then you will speak about the topic for one to two minutes. I will stop you when the time is up.

open.format.part3.text: Today you will practice Part 3 of the Speaking test. This part lasts four to five minutes. We will discuss some general questions. Please give your opinions and explain your reasons as fully as you can.

open.purpose.text: This is a practice IELTS Speaking test. It is recorded so that your performance can be assessed.

p1.end.text: Thank you. That is the end of Part 1.

p2.intro.text: Now, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you are going to say. p2.notes.away.text: Thank you. You can put your notes away now.

p2.nudge.text: Can you start speaking now, please?
